Package it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model

package it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model
Provides the server-side domain model for Mesos.

This package groups the core abstractions used to represent game state, boards, cards, players, lobbies, orchestration services, and the factory components that build complete game instances. The nested packages split these responsibilities into focused areas of the model while keeping all game-domain logic under a single namespace.
